note: Four modes run at once, under two postures. Funding is BROAD — high coverage, no NYC requirement. The other three are TIGHT — only concrete, current or near-term NYC office demand or headcount growth that actually triggers real estate needs. Research qualifies; it does not score. Fit Score belongs to crm-core's scoring lane and runs after intake.

funding.label: Funding & Valuation
funding.goal: High coverage of legitimate funding events.
funding.qualify: (from a watched account OR matches a funding keyword) AND relevant sector AND identifiable

office_expansion.label: Office Expansion
office_expansion.qualify: an explicit concrete office/space statement tied to NYC

hiring_growth.label: Hiring & Team Growth
hiring_growth.goal: Headcount growth of the kind that triggers real estate needs.
hiring_growth.qualify: multiple NYC roles, a senior NYC hire, or a stated NYC team build-out
keywords: building out our New York team

founder_language.label: Founder & Growth Language
founder_language.goal: Founder/CEO statements showing real space pressure.
founder_language.qualify: a first-person founder or CEO statement of space pressure, or a headcount milestone that usually forces a move
keywords: looking for office space in NYC

nycAngle.strong: Explicit NYC office, NYC space search, NYC HQ, or multiple NYC roles.
nycAngle.moderate: NYC HQ or NYC presence stated, without a space or hiring specific.
nycAngle.weak: NYC mentioned only incidentally — a NYC-based investor, a founder who lives there.
nycAngle.rule: fitHint can never exceed what nycEvidence supports. No evidence means 'none', whatever the model claims.

exclusions.note: Biotech/Therapeutics are hard-excluded per crm-core second-pass. Crypto is flagged, never dropped — the score agent owns that judgment.
